content.doc_md: The HTMLelement allows you to display different pictures for different devices or screen sizes. The HTMLelement gives web developers more flexibility in specifying image resources. Theelement contains one or moreelements, each referring to different images through thesrcsetattribute. This way the browser can choose the image that best fits the current view and/or device. Eachelement has amediaattribute that defines when the image is the most suitable. There are two main purposes for theelement: If you have a small screen or device, it is not necessary to load a large image file. The browser will use the firstelement with matching attribute values, and ignore any of the following elements. Some browsers or devices may not support all image formats.
